verdict.rationale: Adyen documents managing the full checkout flows of two named commerce protocols, ACP and UCP, so developers can build against defined protocols. It also publishes OpenAPI definitions on GitHub that can be loaded into Swagger tooling, though nothing shows these cover the agentic APIs specifically. missing for 10: evidence of protocol versioning, a published schema specific to the agentic/ACP/UCP endpoints, conformance or validation tooling (test suites, validators), and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can build against a versioned commerce protocol with a published schema and conformance or validation tooling

citations.quote: Manage the full Agentic Commerce Protocol (ACP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Manage the full Universal Commerce Protocol (UCP) checkout flow on behalf of Adyen merchants.
Adyen returns the created session with UCP envelope, totals, and fulfillment options.
